title: The Hidden Treasure
themeTags: God's love is the greatest treasure
reflectionQuestion: The man was so full of joy that he gladly gave everything for the treasure he found. I wonder what feels like the most precious treasure of all to you?
kidSafetyNotes: Claims OPEN registry anchor hidden_treasure (Jesus' Parables). SHORT-ONLY (tiny one-verse parable; a full would pad). WATCH-ITEM: keep it pure JOY of finding, NOT 'sell everything' guilt/duty -- 'he gave up everything GLADLY, with a great big smile, because the treasure was worth so much more.' Room = God's love/kingdom is the greatest treasure of all, and finding it fills your heart with joy. Soft close ('finding'). VOICE_JAMES_HUSKY (warm storyteller).
